docs.summary: Maps an [`ImageFormat`](#api~Prowl.Aperture.ImageFormat) to the encoder that writes it. PNG is the only format that can be written today; [`Register`](#api~Prowl.Aperture.ImageEncoderRegistry~Register) adds one of your own or replaces a built in.
Every format that currently has an encoder.
Installs an encoder, replacing any existing one for the same format.
Removes the encoder for a format, so saves of it fail with [`NotSupported`](#api~Prowl.Aperture.ApertureError~NotSupported).
